sources.source_name: QuranEnc Arabic Language - Meanings of Words (As-Siraj fi Bayan Gharib Al-Quran)
sources.notes: Official QuranEnc identifies arabic_seraj as v1.0.0 and permits republication only under source-specific conditions. Those terms include no content modification, attribution/version retention, transcript-information retention, and an obligation to update according to newer source versions. That ongoing-update condition is not yet proven compatible with this project's requirement to keep immutable historical snapshots publicly redistributable for long-term reproducibility. Do not capture or mirror production bytes until QuranEnc clarifies archival retention or an equivalent legally durable basis is documented. If archival permission is later cleared, the existing release_requirements still require a source-bound latest-version review before an approved pack may ship.

Licence ambiguity requires resolution before promotion: the official download page presents GNU GPL/verbatim-copy terms, while the official FAQ also describes the data as research/non-commercial. Treat as non-production until the project obtains clarification or a clearly compatible authoritative licence basis.

Official SinaLab resource catalogue labels the Quran morphology dataset CC-BY-4.0, and the 2025 authors describe 77,429 word-level tokens with lemma/POS annotations and chapter:verse:word coordinates. The official download form currently grants the free edition only to users affiliated with a recognized company, university, or institution using a professional official email. No exact artifact was acquired or mirrored in this project. The paper reports 6,235 verses while the current Tanzil Evidence Plane has 6,236 ayah coordinates, so exact-byte coordinate coverage and alignment must be verified before any production promotion or word-tap integration.

Official HadeethEnc currently identifies Arabic v1.7.0 and its download surface permits republication only under source-specific conditions, including no modification, attribution/version retention, transcript-information retention, and an obligation to update according to newer source versions. That ongoing-update condition is not yet proven compatible with this project's requirement to keep immutable historical snapshots publicly redistributable for long-term reproducibility. Commercial-use permission is also not independently verified and remains unknown. Do not capture or mirror source bytes until HadeethEnc clarifies archival retention or an equivalent legally durable basis is documented. If archival permission later clears, preserve the exact then-current artifact and terms, verify edition/collection/numbering provenance, separately verify commercial-use permission, and apply the latest-version release review before any production pack ships.

sources.source_name: MASAQ: Morphologically-Analyzed and Syntactically-Annotated Quran Dataset
sources.notes: Mendeley Data version 5 identifies this full-Quran morphology/syntax dataset as CC BY 4.0. The same dataset record later changed version 6 to CC BY-NC 3.0, while the associated publication and the dataset's Tanzil-derived source-text history create a rights-chain question that this project has not independently resolved. A prior CC grant may remain effective for rights the licensor actually controlled, but this project will not infer downstream rights over third-party material. Do not capture or mirror bytes until the exact version-5 file licence scope, contributor authority, embedded third-party content, commercial-use rights, and durable historical-retention rights are cleared. If cleared, preserve and hash the exact v5 artifact and align its coordinates to the Tanzil Evidence Plane; never substitute its Quran text for the canonical source.

Official Mendeley Data version 1 publicly exposes the Extended Quranic Treebank and labels the dataset CC BY 4.0. Its associated data paper states that foundational Quran text and initial morphological/syntactic material came from Tanzil and the Quranic Arabic Corpus before substantial re-annotation and expert validation. An institutional repository copy explicitly warns that third-party source components remain subject to their respective licences. Because this project already records unresolved commercial/redistribution ambiguity in the Quranic Arabic Corpus terms, the downstream rights scope for embedded or derived third-party components is not yet sufficiently clear for commercial immutable Source Vault mirroring. No EQTB bytes may be captured or consumed by a production pack until the component rights chain, commercial use, redistribution/modification scope, attribution obligations, and durable historical-retention rights are explicitly cleared.

This does not prove QUL lacks permission to host the resource, but it does mean this project has not established a downstream right to archive and redistribute immutable copies. sources.source_name: QAMAR: A New Fully Verified and Accurate Quranic Arabic Morphological Analysis Resource
sources.notes: ACL Anthology publishes the March 2026 QAMAR paper and an optional supplementary ZIP. The paper describes a manually verified morphological layer for every Quranic word with MSA form, stem, lemma, root and POS, but its ethics statement only says the corpus will be open-source for the academic community and publicly available for research and educational purposes. No explicit dataset licence granting commercial redistribution, modification, or immutable historical public mirroring was verified in this review, and the paper says its data came from public sources or was generated without providing a component-by-component rights manifest. Keep metadata-only and do not download/mirror production bytes until both dataset-level rights and component rights are explicitly cleared.
